title: Design: Part deactivated message looks as in the design
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part for this test, part A.
  • Make sure the app is in the Light theme.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1600 pixels wide with the page zoom at 100%, so the screen is as wide as the design boards.
  • Open the attached design picture of board 3.4 at 100% zoom, so you can compare the screen with it.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click Inactive under Part Status.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Click "Deactivate" in the confirmation.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens.

Step 3:

  • The Inactive radio is filled blue.

Step 4:

  • The "Deactivate part?" confirmation opens.

Step 5:

  • The confirmation and the part window close.
  • A green message box appears with a white tick-in-a-circle icon at its left, "Part deactivated." and "Close" at its right.
  • The message box sits at the bottom right of the page.
  • Part A is no longer listed on the Active tab: the list shows the magnifier in a light grey circle with No parts match the search and part A's number.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog), story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List)

  • S13-R22: “Confirming saves every change in the dialog, then applies the status, and closes the dialog with "Part deactivated." or "Part activated.".”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Part deactivated from the part dialog | "Part deactivated." | Success toast, fades on its own”
  • S1-N2: “If a search or filter leaves the Inactive tab empty, it shows the list's standard filtered empty state.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
